    "2026/02/Client-feedback-for-eCom-Gliders-a-Full-service-amazon-account-management-agency.png",
]
base = Path(r"e:/Desktop/Projects/ecomGliders/backup/assets/images/uploads")
for rel in candidates:
    p = base / rel
    if not p.exists():
        # try without size suffix variants
        print(f"MISSING: {p}")

    try:

        print(f"OK {im.size[0]}x{im.size[1]} {im.format} {p.stat().st_size//1024}KB | {rel}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ERR {rel}: {e}")

# Also find catalog/content/listing/ppc named full files not ChatGPT
import os, re
keywords = re.compile(r'(catalog|content.?writ|listing|ppc|account.?manage|visual|creative|seo|a-plus|aplus|infograph|before.?after|seller.?central|dashboard)', re.I)
chatgpt = re.compile(r'ChatGPT', re.I)
found=[]
for root,dirs,files in os.walk(base):
    for f in files:
        if not f.lower().endswith(('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.webp')): continue
        if chatgpt.search(f): continue
        if keywords.search(f):
            found.append(str(Path(root)/f))

for f in sorted(found)[:80]:
    print(f)
print(f"TOTAL keyword matches (no ChatGPT): {len(found)}")
PY

content.text:
## Verdict

Best candidates are the **black-background Amazon mockup set** in `backup/assets/images/uploads/2025/04/{1–8}-1024x1024.png`, plus three files already in `public/images/creative/`. The old homepage **services block used icon-boxes only** (no per-service photos). `content/config/services/*.json` and homepage `services` items have **Lucide `icon` names only** — no image fields.

**Do not use** `*-4.png` / `*-5.png` as “higher-res” versions of those mockups — they are a separate “Other Services” set (Trademark, Email Marketing, Website SEO, Brand Registry, Website Dev, Video Editing, DSP).

---

### 1. Amazon Account Management

| Priority | Path (exists) | Dims / format | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best** | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\backup\assets\images\uploads\2025\04\1-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~170KB | Seller Central laptop: Troubleshooting + Manage All Inventory (real agency SC UI) |
| Strong alt | `...\2025\04\5-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~167KB | Account “AUDIT” dashboard (sales, health, issues) |
| Branded alt | `...\2025\07\Amazon-full-account-management-services.png` | 1600×900 PNG, ~341KB | Explicit “AMAZON FULL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT” agency banner (people + badges; less listing-work feel) |

---

### 2. PPC Management

| Priority | Path | Dims / format | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best** | `...\2025\04\6-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~169KB | Amazon SERP mock with center listing marked **Sponsored** |
| Alt | `...\2026\03\amazon_ppc_management_agency__amazon_ppc_management_services__amazon_ppc_consultant.png` | 668×373 PNG, ~54KB | Brand storefront / Brand Spotlight UI (small) |
| Process graphic | `...\2025\04\Untitled-design-2.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~124KB | Roadmap with “PPC Ads” / CTR (custom brand graphic, not listing photography) |

---

### 3. Listing Optimization and SEO

| Priority | Path | Dims / format | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best (already production)** | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\public\images\creative\search-ranking-optimization.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~128KB | Same asset as backup `3-1024x1024.png`; titled search-ranking / listing SEO |
| Backup source | `...\2025\04\3-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~128KB | Identical source |
| Strong alt | `...\2025\04\8-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~149KB | Magnifier over live listing title + bullets (Bliss Baby) |
| Blog-style alt | `...\2025\06\rank-higher-on-Amazon-...-increase-Amazon-sales.webp` | 1792×1024 WEBP, ~221KB | Ranking/SEO themed (less specific listing craft) |

---

### 4. Content Writing

|---|---|---|---|
| **Best available** | `...\2025\04\8-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~149KB | Focuses on title + “About this item” bullets (closest to copy craft) |
| Weak alt | `...\2025\04\Untitled-design-2.png` | 1024×1024 PNG | Labels “Content Optimization” only |

**Missing:** dedicated A+ narrative / title-bullet rewrite / brand-story still. Nothing named for content writing.

---

### 5. Visual Creativity

|---|---|---|---|
| **Best (real listing creative, production)** | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\public\images\creative\les-plaisirs-cutting-boards.png` | 1000×1000 PNG, ~368KB | Real product main-image style + Amazon badges; Wave A ingest from `2026/02/Client-feedback-...png` |
| Backup source | `...\2026\02\Client-feedback-for-eCom-Gliders-a-Full-service-amazon-account-management-agency.png` | 1000×1000 PNG | Same Les Plaisirs still |
| Strong alt (production) | `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\public\images\creative\listing-image-before-after.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~187KB | Before/after listing photo (from `4-1024x1024.png`) |
| Process alt | `...\2025\04\7-1024x1024.png` | 1024×1024 PNG, ~200KB | Graphic design + 3D rendering monitor (creative process, not Amazon PDP) |

### 6. Catalog Management

**Missing:** variation trees, suppression remediation, or multi-ASIN catalog cleanup imagery. Shares best asset with Account Management.

---

## Source notes (Verified)

| Source | Finding |
|---|---|
| `backup/pages/homepage.html` | “Pro-level Amazon Account Management Services” = Font Awesome / theme icon-boxes only; no service card images |
| `content/config/homepage.json` → `services` | Titles + Lucide icons; **no `image` fields** |
| `content/config/services/*.json` | Hero copy + Lucide icons; **no image URLs** |
| `docs/research/DOWNLOAD-LOG.md` | Logs Wave A creative: Les Plaisirs, `3-1024` → search-ranking, `4-1024` → before/after |
| `docs/qa/HOMEPAGE-VISUAL-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md` | Services = “No service imagery; Lucide icons + text cards” |
| `assets/` | Almost no raster service imagery (AI SVGs + design-color JPEGs only) |

---

## What’s missing / avoid

- **No dedicated set of 6 service-card images** wired for homepage services (gap called out in visual audit).
- **Content Writing** and **Catalog Management** have no unique assets; must share listing/SC stills.
- Prefer the `*-1024x1024.png` Amazon mockups over ChatGPT blog thumbs, `otherservices-main-image.png` (stock portrait), and the `*-4`/`*-5` “other services” illustrations.
- If you need six distinct cards: Account=`1`, PPC=`6`, Listing SEO=`3` (or public copy), Content=`8`, Visual=`Les Plaisirs` or `4`, Catalog=reuse `1` or commission a catalog-specific still.
